build_modelopt_fp8_config: build a ModelOptFp8Config instance from a quantization config dict with FP8 algorithm and ignore patterns
create_modelopt_fp8_linear_method: create a ModelOptFp8LinearMethod to quantize diffusion model linear layers with FP8 weights and scales
test_is_layer_ignored: test whether a layer prefix matches the ignore patterns in a ModelOptFp8Config
run_fp8_linear_apply: run FP8 quantized linear inference by applying ModelOptFp8LinearMethod with input tensor and optional bias
review_process_weights_after_loading: review how process_weights_after_loading transposes FP8 weights and computes per-tensor scales for diffusion model layers
